about: log and exp of a percentage, min of one thing, max and ceil of nothing, and exp overflowing.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 1
model: tiny
title: functions at the edges
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  stored:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB
    value: 15
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "what is held, as stated for this case"}

  index:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: GB
    value: 500
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the index, as stated for this case"}

  disk_per_host:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB/host
    value: 2
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the disk each host has, as stated for this case"}

  share:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: percent
    value: 25
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "stated for this case"}

  logged:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: log(share) + exp(share)

  single_min:
    kind: derived
    unit: TB
    formula: min(stored)

  empty_max:
    kind: derived
    unit: TB
    formula: max()

  bare_ceil:
    kind: derived
    unit: TB
    formula: ceil()

  huge:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: exp(share * 100000)

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - logged
  - single_min
  - empty_max
  - bare_ceil
  - huge
  - index
  - disk_per_host
files.scenarios/reference.yaml:
scenario: reference
title: Reference
because: the model as declared
samples: 1000
seed: 20260916
overrides: {}
